title: FBI Photo A002
sensor_system_note: A-series — different sensor system from B-series. Small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row, NO timestamp visible, '5' scale mark only. A001-A006 are aerial terrain views (sensor pointed down at ground). A007 is the polarity-anomaly frame (sky background, bright specular target). A008 is sky background with normal dark-on-light polarity. Treat as adjacent-not-paired with B-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white aerial/thermal surveillance still with targeting reticle
pages.description: A grayscale aerial or thermal imaging frame showing terrain from above, with mottled textures suggesting vegetation, open ground, and scattered features. A crosshair/targeting reticle is positioned near the center-right of the frame, consisting of a central cross with graduated tick marks extending horizontally and vertically. A small dark round shape is visible just to the right of the reticle center. Several solid black rectangular bars are overlaid across the image, likely redactions or masking, positioned along the top, left, right, and bottom edges. A small numeral is faintly visible along the horizontal scale to the right of center.
